perks.name: Old Martian Diplomacy
perks.description: Stowing a weapon after defeating a powerful combatant or a Guardian heals you a small amount and disorients nearby combatants.
perks.exact:
On Weapon Stow after scoring an Elite+ or Guardian Weapon Kill:
Restores 40? HP and disorients Combatants within 12 meters.
Incurs a 2? second cooldown between activations

perks.name: High Noon
perks.description: Freshly drawn weapons deal increased precision damage to combatants for a short period. Weapons with the Tex Balanced Stock Origin Trait equipped or Exotics manufactured by the Tex Mechanica Foundry gain further increased benefits.
perks.exact:
Upon readying a weapon:
7% Increased Weakspot Damage against Combatants for 4 seconds.
Buffs "Precision Hits" against Shielded Combatants and works on weapons without Precision Multipliers as long as they hit the weakspot.
Weakspot Buffs do not work on a Divinity Bubble

Bonus is doubled to 14% Increased Weakspot Damage for the following:
Weapons with the Tex Balanced Stock Origin Trait and Tex Mechanica Exotics.
Dead Man's Tale | Huckleberry | Last Word | Tarrabah | Chaperone | Prospector
